content: An abstract may contain some `easy' and some `difficult' sentences. We thus perform our analysis at the sentence level. We split abstracts into sentences using spaCy. We excluded sentences that comprise fewer than two tokens, as these are likely an artifact of errors in sentence splitting. In total, this resulted in 57,505 and 2,428 sentences in the train and test set abstracts, respectively.
